reading.text: My family has a new house. My father built it with his friends. It has two floors. The kitchen is downstairs and the bedrooms are at the top of the stairs. reading.title: A Dark Evening
reading.text: Last night I came home late. The street was dark. I opened the front door and went in. It was very dark, so I looked for the light switch. I could not find it. Then I knocked into a chair. My brother heard the noise and came to answer the door. He turned on the light. "Why didn't you ring the bell?" he asked. I laughed. The light bulb in the hall was broken, so I changed it. Now I always lock the door and leave the light on.

reading.text: This winter is very cold. It snows every day. At home we turn on the heating in the morning and we turn it off at night. Our flat has central heating, so every room is warm.
